OpenAI reports its internal GPT-6 Astra completed about 10% of rubric items framed as safety research versus 16% framed as capabilities, with no cause found. Self-reported.
The biggest pro-AI super PAC network ends the midterms with $20M+ of its ~$100M, having mostly backed safe candidates; its riskier bets fell flat.
Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude: read-only Plaid access to bank and card accounts, up to two years of transactions, and hub chats not used for training.
Amazon tells engineers to stop 'tokenmaxxing': usage metrics turned into targets are 'deeply flawed', and the company prefers long-term outcomes.
